items.title: Witch with a Mushroom Basket
items.alt: A kneeling forest witch examines a spotted mushroom while holding a gathering basket.
items.description: A forest witch in ankle boots kneels with a spotted mushroom in one hand and a basket of woodland finds in the other. Use this illustration for personal woodland story cards and fantasy crafts.

items.title: Witch Hanging an Herb Bundle
items.alt: A witch hangs a leafy herb bundle on a wooden drying rail.
items.description: A witch standing on a low stable step stool ties one leafy herb bundle to a short wooden drying rail; two other bundles hang apart. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.

items.title: Witch Repairing a Broom
items.alt: A seated witch binds straw onto a broom handle with twine.
items.description: A seated witch ties a compact broad straw bundle to a broom handle with twine; a spare bundle rests beside her boots. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.
